description: This Java source file defines the PackageInfo class, which acts as a container for a package containing classes and interfaces, providing methods to retrieve, create, and iterate over class information within a package.

classes.name: PackageInfo
classes.description: Container for a package of classes and interfaces, managing class entries and providing access to class data.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the package.

methods.name: getClass
methods.description: Retrieves a class within the package by name.

methods.name: getOrCreateClass
methods.description: Retrieves a class by name, creating it if it does not already exist.

methods.name: getClassIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator to traverse all classes within the package.
